title: Credit scores and credit-report concepts
overview: A credit score summarizes aspects of reported borrowing and repayment behavior using a provider's model. Different models and lenders can interpret information differently; a score is not a guarantee of approval or a complete picture of affordability.
procedure: For a general enquiry, review your report through its authorized provider and use its correction process for suspected errors. The demo assistant does not access real reports, promise a score increase or recommend personalized borrowing decisions.

title: Interest, simple interest and compounding
overview: Interest is the cost of borrowing or a return paid under a deposit agreement. Simple and compound calculations treat accumulated interest differently, while frequency and product terms affect the result; a headline rate alone may not describe all costs.
procedure: For bank-specific examples, Call Sense Bank uses the configured synthetic product rates only. Ask which product and tenure you mean before comparing terms; the assistant never substitutes a guessed live rate for missing configuration.

title: Banking support and choosing a service
overview: Call Sense supports banking information, synthetic account enquiries and human handoff. It distinguishes educational explanations from bank policy and from verified demo records, so not every question requires account access.
procedure: Describe whether your question concerns an account, a card, a payment, a deposit or a loan. The assistant can ask a focused clarification, retrieve approved guidance, or prepare a demo-agent case when the issue needs human authority.
